name: Infiltrator Protocol
summary: Infiltrator Protocol; Gain proficiency in Stealth. Once per short rest, as a bonus action, become hidden from creatures relying on standard vision or auspex until the end of your turn, provided you have cover or concealment.  Infiltrator; You may move 10 ft as part of the bonus action used to activate Infiltrator Protocol.  Infiltrator; When hidden from auspex or standard vision, your next hit deals +1d8 damage. descriptionMarkdown:
Infiltrator Protocol; Gain proficiency in Stealth. Once per short rest, as a bonus action, become hidden from creatures relying on standard vision or auspex until the end of your turn, provided you have cover or concealment.

Infiltrator; You may move 10 ft as part of the bonus action used to activate Infiltrator Protocol.

Infiltrator; When hidden from auspex or standard vision, your next hit deals +1d8 damage.

Infiltrator; You may remain hidden after a miss.
